items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Buddy Collette and Benny Carter and Red Callendar. And these guys were, you know, they were very, very instrumental in really getting the show on the road.

ctx.x: Marl and Buddy and those guys, they were just marvelous, you know, in getting into this amalgamation thing.

So Marle -- I said, "Well, Marl, I don't know. I've never done anything like this. I don't know if I could serve. Maybe you could think of somebody else who could serve better than I, you know." I said, "I haven't had any experience." He said, "Never mind. You're the type of person we want on this, you know, on this Board." And Tran/chitella was the first one to think about it.
